what: a relic shaped like a heart, the simple heart shape of a playing card, made of hard glossy black shell like the back of a great black beetle. It is clad in three overlapping curved plates of bright engraved gold, like a locust's armour, which cover its upper half; the pointed lower half is bare glossy black. In the gap between the gold plates one slit of fierce amber-yellow fire glows from inside. It is a hard, clean, jewel-like thing, like a piece of a king's treasure.
colours: Glossy black shell, bright yellow gold plates with dark engraving, one glowing amber-yellow slit.
pose: Lying by itself, seen from a little above.
must_show: black shell with gold armour plates

what: one big cut gemstone in the simple heart shape of a playing card, a dark wine-coloured garnet with large flat facets, nearly black at its edges and glowing deep ruby in the middle, with one white glint. A ring of six thick black iron spikes is clamped round its widest part like a cruel little crown, the spikes pointing outward. It is a hard, clean, cold jewel.
colours: Dark oxblood garnet glowing deep ruby in the middle, black iron spike ring with grey lit edges, one white glint.
pose: Lying by itself, seen from a little above.
must_show: heart-shaped dark ruby gem with facets
ring of black iron spikes round it

what: a dragon's heart turned to a hard relic: a fat lump in the simple heart shape of a playing card, covered all over in big overlapping black dragon scales like the scales of a pine cone, each scale edged with a dull grey shine. Down its middle runs one wide crack, and the crack is packed with bright gold: a seam of gold coins and molten gold shining out from inside, with two tiny ruby glints.
colours: Black and dark iron-grey scales, one bright seam of yellow gold down the middle, two small ruby glints.
pose: Lying by itself, seen from a little above.
must_show: heart shape covered in black scales
bright gold seam down the middle

what: a heart made of stone: one thick triangular block of rough-hewn dark grey granite with three blunt corners, one corner pointing down, its faces chipped and its edges pale. A deep crack shaped like a small triangle is cut into the middle of its front, and the crack is filled to the brim with pale ghostly cyan light. Plainly a lump of hard rock, heavy and cold.
colours: Dark charcoal-grey and mid-grey granite with pale grey chipped edges, pale cyan light in the crack.
pose: Lying by itself, seen from a little above.
must_show: pale cyan glowing crack in the middle

what: one ember from a fire giant: a rough round lump of black cooled lava rock as big as a fist, knobbly and pitted, split all over by a net of wide deep cracks that glow molten yellow-orange from the fire inside it. From its top one short thick tongue of bright orange and yellow flame rises, joined to the rock, no taller than half the lump.
colours: Black lava rock, wide glowing molten yellow-orange cracks, one small bright orange and yellow flame on top.
pose: Lying by itself, seen from a little above.
must_show: black rock with glowing molten cracks
one small flame on top, joined to it

what: one enormous wolf's fang: a single thick curved tooth of clean ivory-white, broad at its root and tapering to a sharp point, as thick as a thumb at the root, with a pale grey shadow down its inner curve. Round the broad root is clamped one heavy broken shackle ring of dark iron with a single broken chain link hanging from it, touching the tooth. A little white frost rimes the iron.
colours: Clean ivory-white tooth with pale grey shading, a dark iron shackle ring and one link, white frost.
pose: Lying on a diagonal, the broad root at the bottom left and the sharp point at the top right.
must_show: dark iron shackle ring round its root

what: one single huge dragon scale lying flat: a thick curved plate shaped like a broad teardrop, round at the top and coming to a point at the bottom, with one raised ridge down its middle. It is jet black like polished coal, glossy, black in every part, with one broad white-grey streak of shine down the left of the ridge and a faint dull grey shimmer on the right. Its whole rim is a thick band of pale bone-white, chipped along the bottom. Hard as iron, like a plate of black armour.
colours: Jet black like polished coal with a white-grey streak of shine, a thick pale bone-white rim.
pose: Lying flat by itself, seen from the front and a little above, point downward.

what: a crown made from the two horns of a great white bull: a broad circlet band of gold as wide as three fingers, set with a row of square dark garnets, standing upright with nothing inside it, the dark empty inside of the ring showing. From the left and right sides of the band rise two long thick ivory-white bull's horns, each curving outward and then up to a sharp tip, and each tip is capped with a small cone of bright gold. A tuft of short white bull's hide is bound to the band at the root of each horn.
colours: Bright yellow gold band with dark garnets, long ivory-white horns with pale grey shading, gold caps on the tips only, white hide tufts.
pose: Upright, seen from the front and a little from above, as if hung in the air, empty.
must_show: gold caps on the horn tips

what: a short thick piece of a giant's bone, snapped off at both ends, like a stout section of log made of chalk-white bone with a knuckle swelling at one end. The near broken end faces the viewer and shows that the bone is a hollow tube packed solid with bright clear ice: a round core of pale cyan ice glowing in the middle of the white ring of bone. Thick white frost and four short stout icicles cling to the bone.
colours: Chalk-white bone with pale grey shading, a bright pale cyan ice core, white frost and clear pale cyan icicles.
pose: Lying on a diagonal, the knuckle end at the bottom left and the broken open end at the top right, turned toward the viewer.
must_show: glowing pale cyan ice core in its broken end

what: a witch's tongue kept as a charm, dried flat and hard like old leather, harmless, hanging from a cord and seen from the front: one flat tongue, short and very broad, nearly as wide as it is long. Its top edge is cut straight across and is as wide as the rest; its two sides run straight down; its bottom end is one wide, fully rounded tip. One deep black groove runs straight down the middle of it from the top edge almost to the tip, and its surface is rough and pebbled. It is a dull dusky red, the faded red of an old brick, paler and dusty in the middle, darker at the edges. A hole is punched through it near the top edge, and through the hole is knotted a short loop of thick black cord that stands up above it, with one small silver bell tied at the knot. Nothing about it is wet.
colours: Dull dusky brick red with a black groove, paler dusty highlights; thick black cord; one small bright silver bell.
pose: Hanging straight down from its loop of cord, the straight-cut root at the top, the wide rounded tip at the bottom, seen from the front.
must_show: short broad flat dull-red tongue with a black centre groove, rounded tip downward
loop of black cord and one small silver bell at the top

what: a devil's inkwell: a squat round pot of polished gold, wider than it is tall, with a wide open mouth, full to the brim with glossy deep blood-crimson ink, the round pool of ink plainly seen from above with one white glint on it. Two short curved black horns rise from the pot's shoulders, one on the left and one on the right, like handles. One small round dark ruby is set in the front of the pot.
colours: Polished yellow gold pot, glossy deep crimson ink, two black horns, one dark ruby.
pose: Standing upright, seen from the front and a little from above.
must_show: pool of deep crimson ink in its open mouth

what: an ancient Greek flask of gorgon's blood: a small round-bellied bottle of thick dark wine-crimson glass with a short neck, filled to the top so that nothing can be seen through it and the backdrop does not show through. One thick emerald-scaled snake with a pale yellow belly is coiled twice round the belly of the bottle and up the neck, and its head, with two bright yellow eyes, rests on top of the mouth as the stopper. The snake is part of the bottle, wrought of enamelled metal.
colours: Dark wine-crimson glass, an emerald snake with a pale yellow belly and bright yellow eyes, one white glint.
pose: Standing upright, seen from the front and a little from above.

what: one large precious gemstone shaped like a teardrop, round at the bottom and drawn up to a point at the top, smooth and polished like a black opal. The stone is dark, nearly black and glassy, and deep inside it lie broad flakes of coloured fire, each as big as a thumbnail and well apart from the others: flakes of scarlet, of emerald, of golden yellow and of white, scattered over the whole stone like the scales of a fish. A broad curved streak of bright white shine runs down its upper left side, and a thin pale line of light follows its whole outline so its shape is clear. A hard, cold, precious jewel.
colours: A black opal: glassy black body with separate flakes of scarlet, emerald, golden yellow and white inside it; a white streak of shine and a thin pale outline of light.
pose: Upright by itself, point at the top, seen from the front.
must_show: one dark teardrop gemstone, point at the top
flakes of scarlet, emerald, yellow and white inside it
white shine so it reads on a dark floor

what: a bough of holly cut for midwinter: one short thick dark brown woody stem, and growing from it about seven large stiff holly leaves, each leaf glossy dark emerald with a pale midrib and big sharp spikes along its wavy edge, the leaves fanned out and overlapping. At the middle, where the leaves meet, sits one tight cluster of five big round bright scarlet berries. The leaves are large and bold, each a third as long as the whole bough.
colours: Glossy dark emerald leaves with paler midribs, bright scarlet berries, a dark brown stem.
pose: Lying on a diagonal, the cut end of the stem at the bottom left, the leaves at the top right.

what: a soldier's loaf of twice-baked bread: one small round domed loaf, hard as wood, with a thick dark golden-brown crust dusted with pale flour and scored across the top with four deep cuts that divide it into eight wedges like the spokes of a wheel. Rough, dense and hand-made, a medieval campaign ration.
colours: Dark golden-brown crust, pale flour dusting, darker brown in the cuts.
pose: Lying by itself, seen from a little above.
must_show: deep cuts dividing the top into wedges

what: one big wedge of hard cave-aged cheese cut from a wheel: a thick triangular slice like a slice of cake, its sharp point toward the viewer at the bottom right and its curved back at the top left. Its flat top and its two flat cut sides are pale butter-yellow, firm and crumbly, with a few fine cracks and no holes. The curved back of the wedge is a thick rough rind of dark brown, like bark, dusted with pale grey.
colours: Pale butter-yellow inside, a thick dark brown rind dusted with pale grey.
pose: Lying by itself, seen from a little above.
must_show: one triangular wedge of pale yellow cheese
dark brown rind on its curved back

what: a bundle of dried smoked meat: five thick flat strips of jerky laid side by side in one tight bundle, each strip dark mahogany-brown with a dry wrinkled leathery surface and paler brown streaks of grain, their ends ragged. The bundle is tied round its middle with three turns of thick pale twine in a knot.
colours: Dark mahogany-brown meat with paler brown grain, pale straw-coloured twine.
pose: Lying on a diagonal, its lower end at the bottom left corner and its upper end at the top right corner.
must_show: bundle of flat dark dried meat strips
pale twine tied round the middle

what: a traveller's food parcel: a fat square packet wrapped in dark brown waxed cloth, tied crosswise with thick pale twine knotted on top. The top flap is folded back, and in the opening sit three thick square hard-tack biscuits, pale cream with rows of small holes pricked in them, and a few dark dried figs and apricots tucked beside them. Hand-made, medieval, plain.
colours: Dark brown waxed cloth, pale straw twine, pale cream biscuits, dark brown and amber dried fruit.
pose: Lying by itself, seen from a little above.
must_show: brown cloth parcel tied with twine
square pale biscuits showing in the opening

what: fine waybread baked by the Fair Folk: one small round flat loaf, a thick disc of very pale cream-white bread with a thin golden-brown crust round its edge. Pressed deep into its top is one big star with eight points that reaches nearly to the edge of the loaf, its grooves baked golden-brown. The loaf sits on a square of silver-grey silk cloth whose four corners are folded up against its sides, and a thin silver cord is tied once round the cloth. Light, fine and clean.
colours: Very pale cream-white bread with golden-brown grooves and crust; silver-grey silk cloth; a silver cord.
pose: Lying by itself, seen from a little above.
must_show: big eight-pointed star pressed into its top

what: a brick of pressed provisions from the abyss: one dense rectangular block, twice as long as it is wide, of dark charcoal-black pressed stuff with a grainy surface, with sharp pressed edges and one corner broken off roughly. A deep band is stamped across its top, and inside the band and along every edge it catches a cold pale lilac light, so its shape reads clearly. The broken corner shows a paler slate-grey grainy inside flecked with pale lilac specks.
colours: Charcoal-black with pale lilac lit edges, a slate-grey grainy inside with lilac specks.
pose: Lying on a diagonal, its lower end at the bottom left corner and its upper end at the top right corner.

what: one fresh crisp apple, round and plump, deep scarlet with a streaked yellow flush on one cheek, a short brown stalk in the dimple at the top with one dark emerald leaf on it, and one bright white glint on its skin. A real orchard apple, painted true to life.
colours: Deep scarlet with a yellow flush, a brown stalk, one dark emerald leaf, a white glint.
pose: Standing upright, seen from the front and a little from above.

what: an apple made entirely of solid polished gold: the round plump shape of an apple with a dimple at the top, every part of it bright mirror-polished yellow gold with deep brown-gold shadows and a hard white gleam on its shoulder. Its short stalk and its one leaf are gold too, the leaf with fine veins chased into it. A treasure of the gods, heavy metal, not a fruit to eat.
colours: Bright polished yellow gold everywhere, deep brown-gold shadows, a white gleam.
pose: Standing upright, seen from the front and a little from above.
must_show: apple shape entirely of polished gold

what: one heavenly peach, large and plump, shaped like a round heart with a small point at the bottom and a soft crease down its front. Its velvety skin is creamy pale yellow at the bottom, blushing to deep rosy pink at the top and the point. At the top is a short brown stalk with two long slender dark emerald leaves, one to each side. A faint gold shine lies on its cheek.
colours: Creamy pale yellow blushing to deep rosy pink, two dark emerald leaves, a brown stalk.
pose: Standing upright, seen from the front and a little from above.
must_show: plump peach with a crease and a pointed bottom

what: one perfect ripe plum hanging from a twig: at the top a short thick piece of dark brown twig lying level, and from its middle, on a short stalk, hangs one large oval plum of deep royal purple, with a pale dusty lilac bloom on its skin, a shallow crease down its front and one white glint. The plum is the main thing and is twice as wide as the twig is thick. Flawless and tempting.
colours: Deep royal purple with a pale lilac bloom, a dark brown twig and stalk, a white glint.
pose: Hanging straight down from its twig, seen from the front.
must_show: hanging from a short brown twig

what: one magic carrot: a fat, thick, tapering carrot root, bright glowing orange, brightest and almost yellow along its middle as if lit from inside, with a few shallow rings round it. From its broad top springs a short thick tuft of feathery dark emerald carrot leaves. The root is bold and stout, a third as wide as it is long.
colours: Bright glowing orange with a yellow-orange middle, a tuft of dark emerald leaves.
pose: Lying on a diagonal, the pointed tip at the bottom left and the leafy top at the top right.
must_show: tuft of leaves at the top

what: the food of the Greek gods: a wide shallow ancient Greek drinking bowl of polished gold on a short round foot, with one small loop handle on the left side and one on the right. It is heaped above the rim with a smooth shining mound of thick golden honey-coloured ambrosia, like a mound of glowing honeycomb cream, bright pale gold-white at its top where it glows. The bowl is plain gold with one band of key pattern.
colours: Polished yellow gold bowl, a glowing mound of pale honey-gold, bright gold-white at the top.
pose: Standing upright, seen from the front and a little from above.
must_show: shallow gold bowl with two loop handles on a foot
glowing mound of honey-gold food heaped in it

what: one wild mushroom: a single fat pale mushroom with a broad domed cap of pale cream-white, tipped a little toward the viewer so the underside shows, and the gills under the cap glow a soft pale lilac, the brightest part of it. Its stem is short and very thick, pale cream, a little swollen at the foot with a crumb of dark earth on it.
colours: Pale cream-white cap and stem, softly glowing pale lilac gills, a crumb of dark brown earth.
pose: Standing upright, seen from the front and a little from above.
must_show: one pale mushroom with a broad cap
pale lilac glowing gills under the cap

what: a clump of fungi from the lightless deep: three mushrooms growing joined from one shared foot, a tall one in the middle and a shorter one leaning out on each side, touching. Their caps are tall pointed cones like closed umbrellas, deep royal purple, each cap dotted with five big round spots that glow pale lilac-white. Their stems are thick and pale grey-lilac.
colours: Deep royal purple caps with glowing pale lilac-white spots, pale grey-lilac stems.
pose: Standing upright, seen from the front and a little from above.

what: a bunch of the healing herb yarrow, freshly cut: six stout stalks gathered into one bunch and tied near the bottom with thick pale twine. The stalks carry feathery dark emerald leaves like small ferns, and at the top the bunch spreads into three broad flat heads of tiny white flowers, each head like a small white plate. The white flower heads are the boldest part.
colours: Dark emerald feathery leaves and stalks, flat creamy white flower heads, pale straw twine.
pose: Lying on a diagonal, the tied cut stalks at the bottom left and the white flower heads at the top right.
must_show: bunch of leafy stalks tied with twine
flat white flower heads at the top

what: a bowl of thick stew: a deep round bowl of rough dark brown earthenware with a thick rim, full to the top with thick rich brown gravy. Standing out of the gravy are big chunks: four cubes of dark browned meat, three thick rounds of bright carrot, and two pale chunks of turnip, with a few dark emerald herb leaves on top. Thick, hot and filling; medieval peasant cooking.
colours: Dark brown earthenware bowl, rich brown gravy, bright carrot rounds, pale cream turnip, dark brown meat, a few emerald herb leaves.
pose: Standing upright, seen from the front and a little from above.
must_show: brown stew with big chunks of carrot and meat

what: a cup of violet tea: one small plain round tea bowl of dark brown glazed stoneware, shaped like half a ball, smooth-sided, with a pale speckled rim, sitting on one low plain ring foot. It has no handle and its sides are bare all the way round. It is full nearly to the brim with clear bright violet tea, the round pool of tea plainly seen from above, glowing pale lilac at its middle, with two small dark tea leaves floating on it.
colours: Dark brown stoneware with a pale speckled rim, bright violet tea glowing pale lilac in the middle, two dark leaves.
pose: Standing upright, seen from the front and a little from above.

what: a plain ancient stone tablet: one thick upright slab of cold grey stone with a rounded top like an old gravestone, chipped at the corners, its face flat and blank. In the very middle of its face is one deep round empty socket, a perfectly round hole as wide as a third of the slab, pitch-black inside, made to hold a stone the size of an egg. Along the bottom edge runs a single row of small worn carved marks. Nothing else is on it.
colours: Cold mid-grey stone with pale grey chipped edges and charcoal shadows, one black round socket.
pose: Upright, seen from the front and tilted a little so its thick side edge shows.
must_show: grey stone slab with a rounded top
one round empty black socket in the middle

what: an ancient stone tablet with a glowing stone set in it: one thick upright slab of cold grey stone with a rounded top like an old gravestone, chipped at the corners. Set in a round socket in the very middle of its face, as wide as a third of the slab, is one smooth round gem of deep glowing ruby, like a hot coal, and from the gem a warm golden light spreads over the face of the slab, so that the stone round the gem is lit gold. Along the bottom edge one row of small carved marks burns bright gold.
colours: Cold mid-grey stone lit warm gold round the middle, one deep glowing ruby gem, bright gold marks along the bottom.
pose: Upright, seen from the front and tilted a little so its thick side edge shows.
must_show: grey stone slab with a rounded top
glowing ruby gem set in the middle

what: one small broken splinter of a great ruby-coloured stone: a single jagged chip of smooth glassy stone, twice as long as it is wide, with one rounded polished side and sharp broken faces on the other, pointed at both ends. It is deep glowing ruby, brightest and scarlet in its middle as if lit from inside, nearly black-ruby at its edges, with one white glint. A thick bold chunk, not a thin needle.
colours: Deep glowing ruby, bright scarlet in the middle, dark at the edges, one white glint.
pose: Lying on a diagonal by itself, one point at the bottom left and one at the top right.
must_show: one jagged ruby-coloured chip of stone
must_not_show: cut gem with facets all round

what: an alchemist's wrench of old gold. At the bottom left, the end of the handle is a round ring with a round hole through it. Then comes the handle: one straight flat bar of dull old gold as thick as two fingers, with one small round amethyst set in its middle. At the top right, the head: a broad open jaw shaped like the letter C, its opening facing the top right corner, twice as wide as the handle. Battle-worn, engraved with a few bold alchemists' circles, heavy, plainly a tool.
colours: Dull old yellow gold with brown-gold shadows and bright worn edges, one small amethyst.
pose: Lying on a diagonal, the ring end of the handle at the bottom left corner and the open jaw at the top right corner.
must_show: gold bar handle with a ring at its end
open C-shaped jaw at the top

what: a strange device: a squat square box of dark grey riveted iron with thick brass corners, and in its front one big square window of dark glass. Behind the glass three thick tubes of bright glowing pale yellow light meet at one point in the middle, making the shape of the letter Y: one tube from the top left corner, one from the top right corner, one from the bottom middle. Three small scarlet knobs sit in a row on top of the box. The glowing Y is the boldest thing in the picture.
colours: Dark grey riveted iron, dull brass corners, a dark window, a bright glowing pale yellow Y, three small scarlet knobs.
pose: Standing upright, seen from the front and a little from above.
must_show: square iron box with a dark window
glowing yellow Y of three tubes behind the glass

what: a shimmer of old magic hanging just above a floor, seen from above: one flat whirl of glowing light shaped like a small spiral galaxy, with a bright white round core and three thick curling arms of glowing pale violet light winding out from it, every arm thick and joined to the core. About eight big four-pointed white stars are set in the arms, touching them. Solid, bright and thick, so the whole whirl is one joined shape.
colours: Bright white core, glowing pale violet and lilac arms, white stars.
pose: Flat, seen from directly above, by itself.
must_show: one spiral whirl of pale violet light

what: a prime cut of beef for the cook-pot: one thick slab of raw beef steak, a broad rounded wedge as thick as two fingers, its cut face deep ruby-crimson finely marbled with thin cream-white streaks. A thick band of cream-white fat runs along its curved top edge, and one small round of pale bone shows at the narrow end. A clean butcher's cut, dry and neat.
colours: Deep ruby-crimson meat with cream-white marbling, a cream-white fat band, one small pale bone round.
pose: Lying by itself, seen from a little above.
must_show: thick slab of marbled raw beef
band of cream-white fat along one edge

what: a skein of giant spider silk: one fat hank of thick glossy silver-white thread, wound into a long loop and twisted once in the middle like a figure of eight laid on its side, the strands bold and ropey with pale grey shadows between them. It is bound round the twisted middle with a few turns of the same thread, and one loose end curls out. The whole skein is one thick soft bundle.
colours: Glossy silver-white thread with pale grey shadows, a faint cream warmth.
pose: Lying on a diagonal by itself, seen from a little above.
must_show: one thick twisted hank of silver-white thread

what: one great poisonous thorn broken from a monstrous briar, short and stout: it is only three times as long as its base is wide. It starts from a broad, flared, oval woody base, pale where it was snapped from the stem, and from that base it narrows quickly in one strong hooked curve to a needle-sharp point, a shape like a hooked fang. It is hard and glossy, with nothing fixed to it: dark brown-black over most of its length with a broad pale streak of shine along its outer curve so its shape is clear, and only its last quarter, the tip, is bright poison-yellow, glowing a little. Bold and stout.
colours: Dark brown-black thorn with a broad pale grey-tan streak of shine along the outer curve, a bright poison-yellow glowing tip, a pale tan woody base.
pose: Lying on a diagonal, the broad broken base at the bottom left and the sharp tip at the top right.
must_show: one short stout hooked thorn, broad base narrowing to a point

what: a piece of the void made solid: one perfectly round smooth glossy orb like a ball of black glass. Inside it is deep black with a slow swirl of dark royal purple cloud and about six bright white pin-point stars. A thin bright arc of pale lilac light runs round its upper left edge, and one white glint sits on its shoulder, so its round shape reads clearly.
colours: Black with a dark royal purple swirl, white stars, a bright pale lilac arc on the edge, a white glint.
pose: By itself, seen from the front.

what: the remains of a slain beast, picked clean: one small tidy heap of big pale bones with a horned skull on top. At the bottom lie four thick long leg bones with knobbed ends, crossed over one another, and three broad curved ribs leaning against them, with dark gaps between the bones. Resting on top of the heap, and the biggest thing in it, is the skull of a horned beast: a long heavy skull like an ox's, with a broad brow, two deep black empty eye sockets, a long bony muzzle, and two short thick curved horns, one on each side of the brow, pointing up and out. The jaw is shut. Every bone is clean, dry and bare: there is no flesh, no skin and no fur anywhere.
colours: Chalk grey-white bone with dull grey-brown shading, dug-from-the-ground pale and never gold; black eye sockets and black gaps between the bones; the two horns a darker grey-brown.
pose: Lying in one low heap, seen from the front and a little from above, the skull on top facing the viewer and turned a little to one side.
must_show: one heap of a few big clean bones
one horned beast skull on top

what: a Roman soldier's short sword, a gladius. At the bottom left, the pommel: one big round ball of dark polished walnut wood. Then the grip: short, of pale ivory-white bone cut with four deep finger ridges. Then the guard: a thick half-round block of dark walnut wood, no wider than twice the grip. Then the blade: short, straight and very broad, as wide as the guard, its two edges running level and then narrowing in a long sharp triangular point, bright steel-grey with one raised ridge down its middle. The blade is no longer than twice the hilt.
colours: Bright steel-grey blade with white highlights, dark walnut pommel and guard, an ivory-white ridged grip.
pose: Lying on a diagonal, the pommel at the bottom left corner and the point at the top right corner.
must_show: short broad straight blade with a long point
